# Álvaro Pastor

> Developer who builds MCP servers and helpers that give coding agents memory, file search, page context and desktop control. Based in Spain. Everything below is tested on Windows only.

Only Agent History Search is public. The other tools are in development and not published: there is nothing to install yet, and people can request them on X.

## Published

- [Agent History Search](https://alvaropastor.dev/herramientas/agent-history-search.md): recovers useful information from past conversations across Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, omp and Pi Pocket. Local, read-only, MIT.
- [Repository](https://github.com/alvaropas17/agent-history-search): source, README and setup prompt.

## MCP servers in development

- dom-pick: the user marks an element on a page and the agent gets its selector, HTML, styles and a crop. In React, Next and Svelte, also the source file and line.
- find-everything: answers where files are across the whole PC using the Everything index. Counted 2,339 files in 0.1 s on one machine.
- word-mcp: early development. Controls Microsoft Word without clicks or the clipboard, only on documents it created.
- matt-skills-mcp: unpublished pilot. Exposes Matt Pocock's skills through compact descriptions and loads only the one needed.

## Helpers in development

- agent-sync: one MCP source synced with Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Pi Pocket and OpenCode.
- web-read: reads a page once, stores clean text and answers without dumping it into context.
- windows-computer-use: controls Windows apps and windows. With win-dialog, inspects and clicks native dialogs.
- windows-crash-triage: gets to the crash signature, module and stack without opening a debugger.
- config-checkpoints: saves and restores agent configuration states with git.
